title: monticalia tolimensis
intro: Monticalia tolimensis, commonly known as Tolimán or Tolimán Plant, is a type of plant species from the daisy family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, primarily due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Monticalia tolimensis include pain relief, fever reduction, and the treatment of digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
